title: GenerationRequest
description: Published to generation.requested topic by the platform when a merchant submits a generation prompt.

jobId.description: Correlation ID used to route progress events and the final bundle back to the correct session.

prompt.description: Raw merchant prompt, e.g. 'Build me a notify me when back in stock feature'.

appArchetype.description: Determines what the generator produces. storefront_ui → widgetConfig + handler. backend_only → handler only.

platformApiCatalog.description: Platform HTTP endpoints the widget config actions are allowed to reference.

existingFeatures.description: Slugs of features already deployed for this app, used by the intent agent to avoid conflicts.

priorBundle.description: Included when this is a revision request. Contains the previous FeatureBundle so agents have full context.
